editorial:
Imagine a guy who is actually pretty likable, but he is just terrible at being a criminal. You get to follow this scatterbrained lead character who keeps messing up his heists in the funniest ways possible. The vibe is a mix of stress and heart, as you realize he has finally hit a wall and can't run away from his problems anymore. It feels like a race against time, but with a very human touch because he just wants to make things right with the people he loves before the clock runs out.

The acting is what really sells the story, making you root for a guy who technically does bad things. The pacing stays tight, so you won't find yourself checking your phone, though some of the middle parts drag just a little bit. If you enjoy crime stories with a lot of emotion, you will love this one.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the main character makes that final phone call home to say goodbye and apologize. Just as he thinks he is trapped with no way out, a surprise twist reveals that his mistakes actually tricked the villains into a trap. He manages to clear his name and escape the danger. The movie ends with him leaving the criminal life behind for good to start over with his family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime stories with a lot of heart and funny characters.
